card.name: Syringe and vial handling instructions
card.fires_on: Small gaps, commas or linking words just before a volume or device name in preparation and administration instructions, such as the space before '10 mL' syringe or a comma in a list of needleless connectors.

modes.label: Space before volume
modes.description: The space or digit right before a syringe or vial size like 10 mL, 5 mL or 0.9%.
modes.example: Draw 10 mL from the vial(s) into one<< >>10 mL dosing syringe.

modes.label: Device brand lists
modes.description: Commas or 'of' after trademarked device names in lists of connectors and needles.
modes.example: B-Braun ULTRASITE™, BD-Q SYTE™<<,>> Maximum MAX PLUS™, and B-B

modes.label: Infusion port wording
modes.description: Words in instructions about not injecting into infusion line ports.
modes.example: Do not inject other medications into infusion<< side>> ports or mix with VYVGART

card.writes: It lowers the odds of words like implant, inject and injection coming next, and promotes unrelated tokens.
card.plain: It marks the spot in preparation instructions just before a syringe size or device name is given.
